text:
maria.sales: Hey team — running a live POC with AcmeCorp and they started getting 429s around 10:12am PT during a demo. Demo flow is chat + occasional embeddings (concurrent requests from 8 seats). Can someone help triage quickly? :grimacing:

chris.se: Thanks — can you paste a sample request_id from the 429 response? Also which model/route they hit?

maria.sales: Request id: abc123-def456. Route: /v1/generate (model:redwood-chat-xxl). They said it was spike-y when multiple users pasted long transcripts (~8k tokens).

owen.support: Looking at logs for abc123-def456 — 429 reason: "per_route_quota_exceeded" and header shows `X-RateLimit-Route-Burst=10` and `X-RateLimit-Route-Limit=100/min`. So they hit the burst window threshold.

maria.sales: So burst is just 10 concurrent tokens? that seems low given demo. Can we bump for POC?

toni.platform: Quick explainer — we have two levers: 1) per-route burst (short-lived concurrent window) and 2) token budgets (minute/hour). If customers have many concurrent interactive seats with long contexts, both matter. The burst window is sized for steady workloads, not multi-seat demos.

chris.se: Actionable options: (A) Temporarily increase per-route burst for AcmeCorp via console -> Routes -> override burst to 40 (safe short-term). (B) Add a fallback route in routing policy to `redwood-chat-large-quant` for heavy transcripts to reduce token weight. (C) Advise usage pattern change: truncate older context or enable KV prefix caching.

maria.sales: Which is fastest to unblock during demo?

owen.support: Console change is fastest — I can apply a temporary override for this tenant to bump burst to 40 and extend minute token window if you confirm. Will also monitor for errors.

maria.sales: Please do. Also customer is worried about cost — they asked why tokens spiked so high.

toni.platform: Long contexts = more input tokens. Embeddings + chat multiplies token usage: e.g., if each seat sends 8k tokens and 8 seats do that in 2 minutes, minute window explodes. Suggest enabling token-aggregation metrics for the tenant and share the usage breakdown after the demo.

chris.se: For long-term POC: recommend a route-level rule that routes transcripts > 4k tokens to a quantized model and reduces per-request token multiplier. We can also set `route_token_weight` to 0.6 to reflect cheaper model.

rl-bot: deployment-bot: applied route override for tenant:acme-corp — per-route-burst=40 until 2026-03-21T20:50:00Z. Monitor: https://console.redwood.com/tenants/acme-corp/routes

maria.sales: Confirmed demo resumed and no more 429s. Huge thanks. Can we capture post-demo notes so sales + engineering have a checklist?

nowen.support: I'll drop a short checklist: 1) verify route burst and token windows pre-demo, 2) enable fallback/quantized route, 3) set expectations with customer about long-context costs, 4) request post-demo usage snapshot from billing. I'll post it in the POC playbook channel.

chris.se: Also logging tip for future triage: run `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $RL_TOKEN\" \"https://api.redwood.com/v1/logs?request_id=abc123-def456\"` to fetch the trace; look for `quota_decision` fields.

maria.sales: Awesome — thanks everyone. tagging this as resolved for now. :tada:
